provenance.method: 2020 interior LPDs live in the openstudio-loads gem's space-type records (lighting_per_area W/ft2, transcribed by legacy from Tables 4.2.1.5/4.2.1.6 — spot-verified against the codes MCP incl. all three atrium height bins 4.2/5.2/6.5 W/m2). LED alternatives vendored here (led_lighting_2020.json, legacy MERGED table). Occupancy-sensor/personal-control factors (Table 4.3.2.10) live in the space-type keys occ_sense / rel_absence_occ / personal_control. Runtime never contacts the MCP.

atrium_led.note: legacy NECB2017-lineage LED atrium LPD equations, W/m2 = intercept + slope x height(m), converted x0.092903 to W/ft2. LEGACY DEFECT: the legacy method references an undefined space_height variable (NameError if ever executed — no archetype has an atrium); this gem uses the computed height.

articles.title: Occupancy Controls (interior)
articles.how: modeled as the NECB2015-lineage lighting-schedule synthesis (hourly x (1 - rel_absence_occ x occ_sense - personal_control) when occupancy < rel_absence_occ) for space types with LPD > 8.6 W/m2, using the Table 4.3.2.10 factors carried in the space-type data
articles.gaps: control HARDWARE (sensors) is not modeled as objects; area-threshold occupancy-sensor space-type cloning is 2011-only machinery (no-op in 2015+, out of scope)
